summary: Lightweight backend re-verification after APP_BASE_URL was switched to the custom domain https://www.kircandanismanlik.com. POST /api/admin/invites returns join_url = https://www.kircandanismanlik.com/join/{code} (verified live: inv_a7f0aa0e0d704a) even with hostile Origin/Referer headers and an origin_url payload pointing elsewhere — env remains the single source of truth. GET /api/admin/invites returns join_url_prefix = https://www.kircandanismanlik.com/join. invite_email() HTML contains the new domain link and no preview/emergent host. Exactly ONE real Resend send to grelligram@gmail.com: email_sent=true, email_error=null, join_url on the new domain. Domain reachability curl: GET / -> 200, GET /join/inv_test -> 200. Regression: test_admin_kb_rbac.py 45/45 pass, test_email_resend.py 17/17 pass (duplicate invite real-send deselected to avoid flooding Resend). Extended test_invite_baseurl.py from 12 to 14 tests (added env-keys sanity + explicit 'no old emergent.host in join_url' assertion); it reads APP_BASE_URL from backend/.env, no hardcoded host. Total 76/76 backend tests pass. All invites created during testing were revoked; GET /api/admin/invites list is empty.

minor.issue: Seeded regular-user session token test_session_seed_001 had expires_at=2026-08-26 and was EXPIRED (today is 2026-08-27), causing 401 instead of 403 on RBAC checks. Re-seeded expiry to +30 days; consider a long-lived expiry in the seed script in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

Still-open items from iteration 8: duplicated APP_BASE_URL resolution logic + inline imports (os, urllib.parse) inside handlers; no startup validation/warning if APP_BASE_URL is empty (would silently fall back to a relative '/join/{code}').
Still-open from iteration 8: company auto-created before the invite is not deleted when the invite is revoked, leaving orphan companies.

critical_code_review_comments: Env change is fully effective: APP_BASE_URL has highest priority in both create_invite and list_invites, so no request-derived host can leak into shared links. Old emergent.host string appears nowhere in backend code or tests.

backend/.env verified intact: MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, STRIPE_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, SENDER_EMAIL=onboarding@resend.dev, CORS_ORIGINS all present. All supervisor services RUNNING (backend restarted, picked up new env).
